sources.locator: Title search: 网络安全供应链风险管理实践（SP 800-161）

statement.zh: **标准**：网络安全供应链风险管理实践（SP 800-161）（Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations (SP 800-161 Rev.摘要写明它的性质：「This publication provides guidance to organizations on identifying, assessing, and mitigating cybersecurity risks throughout the supply chain at all levels of their organizations.」做法是嵌进已有的风险管理：「The publication integrates cybersecurity supply chain risk management (C-SCRM) into risk management activities by applying a multilevel, C-SCRM-specific approach」。§1.
statement.en: **Standard**: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations (SP 800-161 Rev.1) (网络安全供应链风险管理实践（SP 800-161）).

statement.zh: 起点是买方的不可见性。摘要首句：「Organizations are concerned about the risks associated with products and services that may potentially contain malicious functionality, are counterfeit, or are vulnerable due to poor manufacturing and development practices within the supply chain.」并把根源归到过程看不见：「These risks are associated with an enterprise's decreased visibility into and understanding of how the technology they acquire is developed, integrated, and deployed」。
statement.en: The starting point is the acquirer's lack of visibility.The abstract opens: "Organizations are concerned about the risks associated with products and services that may potentially contain malicious functionality, are counterfeit, or are vulnerable due to poor manufacturing and development practices within the supply chain." and attributes it to unseen processes: "These risks are associated with an enterprise's decreased visibility into and understanding of how the technology they acquire is developed, integrated, and deployed".

statement.zh: §2 给出接入点：「C-SCRM should be integrated into the enterprise-wide risk management process described in [SP80039] and depicted in Fig.3.」责任由组织共同承担：「Implementing C-SCRM requires enterprises to establish a coordinated team-based approach and a shared responsibility model to effectively manage cybersecurity risks throughout the supply chain.」并就跨部门输入给出建议（原文 should aim to，不是要求）：「Enterprises should aim to infuse perspectives from multiple disciplines and processes」。§1.4 为不同读者指路，对企业风险管理的读者写：「The entire document is relevant to and recommended for readers fitting this profile.」三句的主语都是企业自身：接入既有的风险管理过程、建立协同团队与共担责任模型、把多学科的视角注入做法；§1.4 的分读只是指引。
statement.en: Section 2 gives the point of attachment: "C-SCRM should be integrated into the enterprise-wide risk management process described in [SP80039] and depicted in Fig.3." The duty is shared organisationally: "Implementing C-SCRM requires enterprises to establish a coordinated team-based approach and a shared responsibility model to effectively manage cybersecurity risks throughout the supply chain." and cross-functional input is advised in should-aim-to terms: "Enterprises should aim to infuse perspectives from multiple disciplines and processes".

statement.zh: 文件自陈两处不做。§1 划出与一般供应链风险管理的分界：「This publication does not address many of the non-cybersecurity aspects of SCRM.」§1.1 说明它不给路线图：「However, this publication does not offer a specific roadmap for enterprises to follow to reach various states of capability and maturity.」并强调须裁剪：「The C-SCRM guidance provided in this document is not one-size-fits-all.」前两句是主题上的分界，第三句是方法上的告诫：实践须按各企业的规模、资源与风险情形裁剪。另有一处限制属于这份副本：页眉写「May 2022 INCLUDES UPDATES AS OF 11-01-2024; SEE APPENDIX K」，而留存文本止于 §2.3.1 的责任表，第 3 章的关键实践与页眉所指的附录 K 都不在这份文本里，其内容在此不作断言。
statement.en: Two exclusions are its own.Section 1 separates C-SCRM from the wider discipline: "This publication does not address many of the non-cybersecurity aspects of SCRM." Section 1.1 declines to give a roadmap: "However, this publication does not offer a specific roadmap for enterprises to follow to reach various states of capability and maturity." and warns against copying it verbatim: "The C-SCRM guidance provided in this document is not one-size-fits-all." The first two mark a subject boundary and the third a method warning: the practices must be tailored to the size, resources and risk situation of each enterprise.

statement.zh: 页眉首行为「NIST Special Publication 800 NIST SP 800-161r1-upd1」，日期行写明「May 2022 INCLUDES UPDATES AS OF 11-01-2024; SEE APPENDIX K」，DOI 行是「This publication is available free of charge from:」，DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-161r1-upd1。出版史块记录评审与取代关系：「Approved by the NIST Editorial Review Board on 2024-09-25 Supersedes NIST Special Publication 800-161r1 (May 2022)」，引用行给六位作者与年份并补一句「Includes updates as of November 1, 2024.」——「Boyens J, Smith A, Bartol N, Winkler K, Holbrook A, Fallon M (2022) Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations.」致谢页另记 2015 年版作者：「the original authors of NIST SP 800-161, Celia Paulsen (NIST), Rama Moorthy (Hatha Systems), and Stephanie Shankles」。
statement.en: The first masthead line reads "NIST Special Publication 800 NIST SP 800-161r1-upd1", the date line reads "May 2022 INCLUDES UPDATES AS OF 11-01-2024; SEE APPENDIX K", and the DOI line reads "This publication is available free of charge from:" followed by the DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-161r1-upd1.The publication history block records the review and the supersession: "Approved by the NIST Editorial Review Board on 2024-09-25 Supersedes NIST Special Publication 800-161r1 (May 2022)", and the citation line gives the six authors, the year and the note "Includes updates as of November 1, 2024.
